Reading the conversation: the customer wants to know when an OEM replacement part, ordered yesterday with a $184 deposit paid, will arrive. That makes parts_order the main type. Warranty was refused, but the customer accepted that and is paying for the part, so warranty_claim is only a secondary theme. They are not asking for coverage now. Escalation: the customer mentions contacting CAMVAP, which is the Canadian Motor Vehicle Arbitration Plan. That is a formal complaint channel, so it counts as a legal threat or formal complaint. It has to go to a person, so request_type is needs_human, with parts_order as secondary and legal_threat as the reason. The customer is correcting the part they named, which is not adversarial. The tie-break says a formal complaint or legal threat goes to needs_human even if another type fits. "Before I contact CAMVAP" is a conditional threat of arbitration, and I treat it as a legal threat. There is also a complaint about staff (Nicole), but it is mild and not the main point.
